subject: Purchase orchestration: milestone plan & risk register
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ramirez <sofia@edgehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Purchase orchestration: milestone plan & risk register

Hi Sofia — great conversation this morning. Quick recap and proposed mutual action plan (MAP) so everyone has the same expectations and next steps. I captured a couple of risks we should track.

Call summary (30m):
- Use case: real-time clinical summarization API for discharge notes; priority: sub-200ms tail latency.
- Target go-live: pilot with 3 clinics by end of Q1 2027.
- Budget: purchasing wants to confirm PO pathway vs. corporate card; finance prefers PO for multi-month commitments.

Proposed procurement milestones (high level):
1) Legal review of MPA (Redwood to provide draft) — target 5 business days for basic edits.
2) Security review / questionnaire (EdgeHealth to send baseline; Redwood returns completed questionnaire + SOC2 evidence) — target 7–10 business days.
3) Finance signoff (billing route: PO vs card; tax/vendor on-boarding) — target 3–5 business days after legal/security signoff.
4) PO issuance & onboarding (procurement sends PO, Redwood issues invoice + onboarding kick-off) — target 2 business days.

Key risks to track (initial):
- Security questionnaire gap: some requests may require additional SSO/KMS details; could add 5–7 days.
- Contract redlines from legal (data locality / audit language) may push timeline if escalated.
- Payment instrument decision (PO vs card) could delay if finance needs vendor setup.

Attachments: I attached a one-page draft MPA, a milestones spreadsheet with estimated owners/times, and a blank security questionnaire (we can pre-fill).

Suggested next steps:
- Sofia: share procurement contact + preferred PO template (if you have one) and confirm who will lead security review (Maya?)
- Ben: I want you on pricing confirmation and any standard SOW language we should pre-populate.
- Marissa: can you own the MPA draft and circulate to legal for internal readiness?

If everyone agrees I’ll propose a target calendar: legal/security signoff 10/29, finance 11/03, PO by 11/05 — all contingent on no major redlines.

Thanks — short roadmap attached.

Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0192

Attachments referenced: redwood-mpa-draft-v1.pdf, procurement-milestones-spreadsheet.xlsx, security-questionnaire-filled.pdf
From: Sofia Ramirez <sofia@edgehealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Purchasing Team <purchasing@edgehealth.com>, Maya Patel <maya.patel@edgehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Purchase orchestration: milestone plan & risk register

Thanks Connor — appreciate the clear MAP. Quick answers from our side:

- Purchasing contact: purchasing@edgehealth.com (CC'd). Use PO route by default; finance prefers PO for any >$10k monthly committments.
- PO template: attaching our standard PO template (I sent it to purchasing inbox).
- Security review: Maya will lead security. She asked if you can return the completed questionnaire + SOC2 link by EOD 10/22.

Potential blockers:
- Legal is thin this quarter — if the MPA has non-standard indemnity/data residency asks, they may escalate to counsel and add ~10 business days.
- Finance vendor setup: expects W9 + bank details from Redwood for new vendor onboarding.

We prefer to keep the pilot under a 3-month commit to limit procurement friction. If you can provide a pilot pricing SKU that fits a PO for the quarter, that will help.

Sofia Ramirez
VP, Clinical Ops
EdgeHealth
sofia@edgehealth.com

- Redwood: finalize MPA draft (Marissa) — deliver 10/20.

Risk register (owner / mitigation):
